title: The lane lint carries across the tool's own records-page commit in this repo, as line 82 of pr-review-record says, so a `--ready` no longer discards the lint
why:
Request (coordinator 21:38 CST Nov 14; triage read no code, PR or record; every fact below is the lane's read, unverified by triage). Lane review-carries-by-tree (session_013NEJKzVWixDqQgAjMzTCgV) read at 21:37 CST, main 6a0a6fa161: claim_only (merge/merge.py:1926) returns False at once when base_stamp gives no kinds, and this repo has none, so the lane lint never carries across the tool's own records-page commit. The record walk (clean_merges_after) has no such gate, so the record carries. Decision pr-review-record line 82 says both carry: the lane reads the code as wrong and the line as right. Measured on #3440: lint PASS at f2ef8191, `--ready` page commit 32a077b40ab8, `--reviewed` reads "no lint". Cost this evening (runner 10's measure, unverified): every lint run before a `--ready` is lost, 8 to 12 min each; 7 repeat lints at 56 min, part of them from main merges. Fix to build: test page_only / page_is_generated before the `not kinds` return; red case first. It is a guard or check change (verdict can change): review rounds and the net-value test apply (rule roles-review-cap-three). The coordinator's pick, undoable, no widening beyond line 82 (a grant covers the act it names, never a variant). Start it after step carry-forgives-main-merge, same lane. Kin: carry-forgives-main-merge (replacement PR; carry and `--fix-check` gate), merge-lint-skip-green-rollup, records-page-before-ready. Item 850 (open question: carry the lint across a clean merge of main) is a DIFFERENT gap: this step is the tool's own page commit, which line 82 already says should carry, so it may shrink item 850's cost; item 850 is not changed. Interim runner order (coordinator, undoable, until this step's lint carries): MARK FIRST, LINT IN PARALLEL: runner 10 marks a handed-in head without waiting for the lint, and runs the lane lint beside it. OWNER PICK 23:07 CST Nov 14 (page item 850, "850 a", ruling own-850-a-lane-lint-carries-clean-main-merge): the lane lint may carry across a clean merge of main in the tool-proved form only (two parents, second on main, tree equals git's own merge, nothing else changed); no variant (conflict-resolved, other change, unreadable = unknown, not carried). Lifts his "a repo changes to fit a shared tool" ruling for this one act. Check change: review rounds, red first, net-value test. The coordinator decides which lane builds it. Kin: that ruling is about the lint across a main merge; this step is about the tool's own records-page commit (pr-review-record line 82). 02:41 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed; triage read no code): lane review-carries builds this PR (the no-stamp page carry) without waiting on a deferred question: may the carry also cover a claim or page commit made AFTER a clean merge of main? Own-850-a leaves that out ("or any other lint-carried form"); decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job (PR 3481) says so. Posted as owner item 868 (pick-carry-lint-after-claim), not blocking, option b (keep the limit) starred as the coordinator's recommendation, option a marked widening. Its tests test_b_a_claim_after_a_clean_merge_is_not_carried and test_b_a_records_page_after_a_clean_merge_is_not_carried assert the current rule; the cost of the claim-or-page case is unmeasured.

11:45 CST Nov 15 (triage): owner answered page item 868 a at 11:39:47 CST (ruling own-868-a-lift-carry-limit), the widening option chosen knowingly against the coordinator's recommendation b: the lane lint also carries across a claim or page commit made after a clean merge of main. This step's own scope (the no-stamp page carry) is unchanged. The widened carry is a separate build and needs its own step; none filed, the coordinator starts it. Two tests re-point (test_b_a_claim_after_a_clean_merge_is_not_carried, test_b_a_records_page_after_a_clean_merge_is_not_carried), and decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job (PR 3481) names own-850-a as the limit, so its sentence changes. Guard or check change: review rounds apply.
